Conference Charter

What the team has agreed on so far, and what is still to do, for the 300-1412 mini-conference.

On this pageObjectiveConference IdentityConference Workflow9-Week RoadmapWeek 1 Deliverables

Objective

Help students see the whole picture of running an academic conference and take on the organizer role themselves, from the call for papers to presentation day.

  • Write your own paper
  • Review other papers
  • Take part in decisions
  • Organize the event
  • Present your research
